text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
(You always keep your head up no
matter what.
Your image shines bright...)

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: This is my true poweeeer!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...King.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...I'm not done yet.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
If you truly wish to learn from me, then
steel
yourself and watch me until the
very end.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! Did you see my graceful,
magnificent
running?!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
That's the first-rate Umamusume we
love! Are you
aiming to conquer the
Dual Sprints again this
year?!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
You should quit while you're ahead and
end your career on a high note. Why
keep fighting to satisfy your ego? That
won't help the newer
generation.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Only I have the right to make that
decision.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
But I will grant you the right to hear me
speak! So
listen well!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
This is a world of victory and defeat.
Today, I
crushed the dreams of many
others to fulfill my
own.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
However, I am proud that I chose to
enter this
race, and I do not feel I was
selfish in the
slightest!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I take pride in making choices that
represent who I am! No matter what
anyone else may say, this is
the path I
tread!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Woohoo! Go King Halo!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
(...Yes,
that's right. She's the role model
I
desperately followed.)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
(She always shines so brightly, no matter
what
pain burdens her.)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Earnest and unafraid, she has the
courage to
move forward as herself.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...King.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
You put in a great effort, but I duly
bested you.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Y-yes. About that, I...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Even though you were my opponent, I do not regret the way I conducted myself today.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't matter how anyone views me. I
made my decisions in order to stay true
to myself, and I
wouldn't call that
selfishness.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
That's why if the day ever comes when
we
compete again, I'll go all out and
give you
another good thrashing.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I won't hold back, no matter my
opponent. That's
how I show respect to
those who challenge me.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
...Right. I'm looking forward to racing
you again!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course. The answer was within me
all
along.
choice_data_list: ……Did you figure out how to draw t...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Some days later, Kawakami Princess
comes to me
with a proposal.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Before the Takamatsunomiya Kinen,
King asked
me whether I felt pride in
myself.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Whether I could take pride in my own
actions.
Whether they reflect my true
self.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
King's words made me realize
something—staying true to myself
doesn't mean I'm being
self-centered. So
I'll keep on moving forward...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
No matter what anyone else might think
of me.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, for next month's Fan Fest, I
want to take
part in this event.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami Princess shows me a plan for a
stage
event.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"Last Year's Tiara Tour in Retrospect!" A
talk
show presented by glamorous
Umamusume...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
It seems the Umamusume I competed
against last
year will be there, as well as
all their fans.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
A true princess wouldn't back down from
an
opportunity like this just because she
felt
intimidated.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I see sincere determination burning in
her eyes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But somewhere deeper, I sense a subtle
tremor, a
trembling accompanied by an
eagerness to grow.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...Right.
